args.body: Dear Mr Clarke, thank you for your email. Our earlier inspection summary said no issues, but the attached report does note two things: a dog flap fitted in the back door/utility room, and sticker-type marks on the Bedroom 1 wall which the tenant is to remove and make good. We have no record of the dog flap or a lock change being approved. We are asking the tenant now who fitted the dog flap and whether the lock was changed, and will come back to you. On the spare front door key, we do not hold a record of one yet and will confirm once the tenant replies. Please note our earlier email was addressed to Oliver Bennett; could you confirm you are the landlord for this property so we can keep our records right? Please also tell us whether you would like to give or refuse consent for the dog flap. Kind regards, Northbridge Lettings
